items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: I've never heard of her. Yeah, she's very, very good. She was with him during that period also.

ctx.x: That's funny, he used Octave Crosby, I guess, when he went in the paddock. Well, that was the time, yes. Yes.
And Mercedes also. Well, Mercedes too. She was with him. I've never heard of her. Yeah, she's very, very good. She was with him during that period also.
That's right, I've heard that but I never did know her. Yes.
